source_fence: No CausalGym import/construct/reset/do, physical source actions, protected/cohort seed, private info, native model admission or first-use. Tests feed only fabricated PublicConsequence records.
hypothesis: A bounded source-independent tokenless temporal memory can propagate actual delayed reward to earlier public actions, preserve context distinctions at identical current states, and cold-restore mid-episode without lookahead.

model.discount: exact integer fixed point; gamma=1/2; future offsets 0..3
model.public_features: previous observed action and reward (2 = no preceding event), current public binary before and chosen action; 36 supported contexts
model.representation: 36 fixed-point sum/count pairs, max4 unfinished public event traces and last predecessor; online accumulation with no future labels at action time; zero gradients and no language tokens
model.cold: hash-verified canonical serialized state including pending trace and complete observed-event digest; this proves corruption detection, not external authenticity
model.context_capacity: 36 event-context keys; exact logical size and serialized bytes reported, no whole-process efficiency claim

controls.strong: independent batch conventional return-to-go tabular estimator on identical public tape and same contexts, expected to tie exactly
controls.no_unique_superiority: An exact match with independent conventional is explicitly SCIENTIFIC_NO_GO.

frozen_tests: strict FKP24-shaped six-field binary public event schema, no extra private fields, atomic invalid rejection
t+2 reward contributes exact 1/4 to event t despite zero immediate reward
same present-state differing predecessor-conditioned contexts remain distinct
terminal/truncated episode stops cross-episode reward propagation
exact interrupted cold-restored stream matches uninterrupted data
tampered hash and semantic-invalid canonical snapshot fail closed
incremental trained mean delayed return exactly equals independent offline batch conventional in all supported keys
model abstains on unsupported public contexts rather than claiming skill
no source imports or upstream first-use actions performed
evidence: Run all focused tests in local isolated Python and compare exact GitHub blob receipts. Record test failures and nulls, never retune claim thresholds post outcome.
restrictions: Only new CVH01 research-only files; do not change accepted main, existing FKP25/WSP121 owner branches, native model, first-use, workflow, runner, scheduler, controller, PR, merge, deployment or paid APIs.
